MigrationWiz Document Migration Errors

Following a system upgrade on August 19, 2026 that improved overall document migration speed and throughput, we have identified an issue affecting a small subset of customers. Some users may encounter one of the following errors during document migrations:

"Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute."
"Offset and length were out of bounds"
"Did not read all bytes from file."

These errors are not indicative of data loss. They are the result of a DLL upgrade included in the August 19 release, which causes logs generated prior to the upgrade to be unreadable by the updated code. We are aware of the issue and actively working on a broader resolution.
 
Recommended Steps
If you are experiencing one of the errors above, please perform a Reset Items and resubmit the migration pass. This resolves the issue in most cases. 

For instructions, see How to Reset Items in MigrationWiz. 
https://help.bittitan.com/hc/en-us/articles/360042167494-MigrationWiz-Statistics-Statistics-Lookup#01H8HEMGW00PCG8XHWPM7QHWJD

If the error persists after performing a Reset Items, please open a Support Case so our team can assist you directly while we work on a broader fix.
 
We will provide updates here as our investigation continues.

incidents.body:
We have resolved the issue affecting OneDrive to OneDrive migrations using Delegate Application authentication. Customers who previously encountered the error message "Your migration failed while checking destination credentials" should now be able to run migrations successfully.
If you continue to experience issues, please resubmit your migration. If problems persist, contact our support team.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
